description: The fixed reply to a mention by someone who is not the agent's owner, with "Answers other people" off (docs/plans/agent-connect-plan.md §3.13), copied from §3.13's table. Shared by Keyring (ConnectedAgents.OthersReply, the preview in the agent's details) and the agent-connect plugin (src/core/others/messages.json), so the two copies cannot drift (§8.1). The English is the source.
status: fr and pt-br drafts, not reviewed (D16)
en: I'm an AI agent and I can't respond to anyone but the person I work for.
fr: Je suis un agent IA et je ne peux répondre qu'à la personne pour qui je travaille.
pt-br: Sou um agente de IA e só posso responder à pessoa para quem trabalho.
